Global (All).title: Cyber-attack on US Government Agency Impacts Citizens' Data
Global (All).summary: A recent cyber-attack on a US government agency has compromised sensitive citizen data, sparking concerns about data protection and national security.

Global (All).title: Social Unrest in Global Cities Over Economic Inequality
Global (All).summary: Protests and demonstrations have erupted in several global cities, highlighting growing concerns about economic inequality and social injustice.

Global (All).title: Global Health Crisis Exacerbated by Pandemic-Related Supply Chain Disruptions
Global (All).summary: The ongoing global health crisis has been worsened by pandemic-related supply chain disruptions, leading to shortages of critical medical equipment and supplies.

United States.title: Tensions escalate between the US and China over Taiwan
United States.summary: The US has sent a clear signal of support to Taiwan, fuelling tensions with China; A US diplomat has met Taiwan's President, causing China's anger to rise.

United States.title: US inflation data shows continued slowdown in price growth
United States.summary: The US inflation rate eased more than expected in July, but is still above the Federal Reserve's target; However, this data might affect interest rates in the next FOMC meeting.

United States.title: Ukraine-Russia conflict: US imposes new sanctions on Putin's allies
United States.summary: The US has imposed new sanctions on several Russian allies, as the conflict in Ukraine continues; These sanctions target oligarchs and other key figures close to Putin.

Japan.title: Japanese Yen weakens to 24-year low against US dollar, sparking worries about economy
Japan.summary: The Japanese yen has reached its lowest level against the US dollar since 1998, fuelling concerns about the country's economic stability and potential impact on its already-struggling economy.

Japan.title: North Korea fires ballistic missile over Japan, sparking international condemnation
Japan.summary: North Korea launched a ballistic missile that flew over Japan, triggering widespread condemnation from the international community and raising concerns about regional security.

Japan.title: Japan's LDP delays leadership election due to COVID-19 cases among candidates
Japan.summary: The ruling Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) in Japan has postponed its leadership election due to COVID-19 cases among some of the candidates, causing uncertainty in the country's political landscape.
